## Analysis of the GSE161731 dataset

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

sample_meta <- read_tsv("data/RNA_sample_metadata.txt.gz", show_col_types = FALSE)
counts_df <- read.delim("data/RNA_count_matrix.txt.gz", check.names = FALSE) |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene_id")
```

## Data Description

Before filtering or transforming the dataset, we inspect the dimensions, missing values, and distributions of both the sample metadata and the raw gene count matrix.

### Metadata Details

```{r}
dim(sample_meta)
names(sample_meta)
```

```{r}
n_distinct(sample_meta$donor)
# number o f unique samples per condition and their purity
count(sample_meta, condition_name, purity_bins)
```

```{r}
#count NAs
na_summary <- colSums(is.na(sample_meta)) |>
  enframe(name = "column", value = "n_na") |>
  filter(n_na > 0)

na_summary
```

### Count Data Details

```{r}
dim(counts_df)
sum(is.na(counts_df))
```

## Clean Data

#### Sample data

```{r}
clean_sample_meta <- sample_meta |>
  select(-c("ips_received","ips_started","passage_received","media","passage_diff","diff_start","salmonella_date","atac_date","flow_date","medium_changes","terminated","open_access","ips_culture_days","passage_diff_bins","rna_extraction","rna_submit","library_pool","chemistry","rna_auto","status","ng_ul_mean","harvest_stimulation_days","macrophage_diff_days","EB_formation","macrophage_harvest","clone"))

```

```{r}
library("table1")

clean_sample_meta |>
  mutate(
    condition_name    = factor(condition_name),
    sex               = factor(sex),
    received_as       = factor(received_as),
    rna_concentration = factor(rna_concentration)
  ) |>
  table1(
    x = formula(~ sex + received_as + rna_concentration + mean_purity | condition_name),
    data = _
  )
```

remove the alive/frozen maybe

```{r}
counts_long <- counts_df |>
  # counts with at least 10 counts in at least 5 samples
  filter(rowSums(counts_df[-1] >= 10) >= 5) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -gene_id,
    names_to  = "sample_id",
    values_to = "counts"
  )

counts_long 
```

remove all lines that have NAs and then inner join

```{r}
clean_sample_meta |>
  filter(if_any(everything(), is.na))

clean_sample_meta <- clean_sample_meta |>
  drop_na()
```

```{r}
merged_data <- counts_long |>
  inner_join(clean_sample_meta, by = "sample_id")

merged_data |>
  distinct(sample_id, replicate) |>
  count(replicate)

merged_data
```

```{r}
gene_summary <- merged_data |>
  group_by(gene_id, condition_name) |>
  summarise(
    mean_counts = mean(counts),
    sd_counts   = sd(counts),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) |>
  drop_na()

head(gene_summary)
```

```{r}
dim(gene_summary)

n_distinct(gene_summary$gene_id)
```
